channel.title: Methodology Feed
channel.description: Aggregated research articles from Nature Biotechnology and Nature Methods.

item.title: Nature Methods: Integration of alternative fragmentation techniques into standard LC-MS workflows using a single deep learning model enhances proteome coverage
item.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 23 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03042-9 An integrated mass spectrometry platform enabling automated collision-, electron- and photon-based fragmentation techniques is presented. A deep learning-based model trained to predict spectra across all dissociation methods further enhances protein identification.

item.title: Nature Methods: Generating 3D models of complex carbohydrates with GLYCAM-Web
item.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 23 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03033-w GLYCAM-Web offers a suite of validated 3D oligosaccharide structure modeling tools via a convenient web server.

item.title: Nature Biotechnology: Generalist biological artificial intelligence in modeling the language of life
item.description: Nature Biotechnology, Published online: 20 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41587-026-03064-w This Review discusses the promises and pitfalls of biological AI algorithms and presents a vision for generalist biological artificial intelligence, in which models can perform diverse tasks across biological domains.

item.title: Nature Biotechnology: Functional integration of an autologous engineered esophagus in a large-animal model
item.description: Nature Biotechnology, Published online: 20 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41587-026-03043-1 A tissue-engineered esophageal segment is functional in minipigs.

item.title: Nature Methods: Open and sustainable AI: challenges, opportunities and the road ahead in the life sciences
item.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 20 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03037-6 This Perspective provides recommendations for open and sustainable AI and associated resources facilitating exploration and implementation.

item.title: Nature Methods: LazySlide: accessible and interoperable whole-slide image analysis
item.description: Nature Methods, Published online: 20 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03044-7 LazySlide combines scverse with foundation models to enable efficient whole-slide image analysis.

item.title: Nature Biotechnology: An engineered E. coli strain sustains intratumoral nitric oxide production to boost effectiveness of tumor immunotherapy
item.description: Nature Biotechnology, Published online: 18 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41587-026-03055-x An engineered Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 strain carrying a synthetic arginine–nitric oxide (NO) circuit enables sustained intratumoral NO production that promotes vascular normalization and immune reprogramming. This reshaped tumor microenvironment synergizes with blockade of the immune checkpoint PD-L1 to reinvigorate CD8+ T cells and drive durable tumor regression in mouse models.

item.title: Nature Biotechnology: Sustained nitric oxide production by engineered E. coli remodels the tumor microenvironment and potentiates immunotherapy
item.description: Nature Biotechnology, Published online: 18 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41587-026-03054-y Solid tumors are sensitized to anti‑PD‑L1 immunotherapy by engineered E. coli to produce nitric oxide.

item.title: Nature Biotechnology: Single-molecule peptide sequencing through reverse translation of peptides into DNA
item.description: Nature Biotechnology, Published online: 18 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41587-026-03061-z Peptides are sequenced by converting each amino acid into amplifiable DNA barcodes.

item.title: Nature Biotechnology: Precise, minimally evolved adenine base editors generated through mutation reversion analysis
item.description: Nature Biotechnology, Published online: 18 March 2026; doi:10.1038/s41587-026-03045-z Base editor precision is increased by reverting established mutations.
